purpose: Test a focused mug fit and stationary release for more reliable complete learned dinner workflows. Preserve the selected suite and all failed experiments.
intervention: Modify only lower/release/retract labels in the 41 existing mug training episodes. Stop lowering at a tool point 1 mm above the original endpoint by interpolation on the existing path. Open fingers over 1.0 seconds with the active arm stationary for 1.25 seconds, then follow the original sideways release path with the same joint offset. Taper the offset to zero through retract. Preserve durations, visual inputs, inactive-arm actions, other stages, architecture, normalization, runtime, 0.35 Nm gripper cap and every physical threshold. Warm-fit the original model, weighting alignment/lowering/release endpoints fourfold. This is a combined intervention, not an ablation proving which component causes any improvement.
training_data_gate: Every one of the 41 revised exact float32 action sequences must pass the unchanged independent DinnerPhysicalMonitor replay before training. Stop if any fails; preserve every result and do not retune within this protocol.

training.initialization: Original v6 mug weights, preserving exact visual/action normalization.
training.loss: Weighted mean normalized motor-target squared error; all endpoints retained.

development_gate: After completed training, CPU export parity and input-hash checks, freeze the baseline and sole candidate suites. Run the actual set-the-table language/RGB engine on every development seed in both presets with both suites, keeping refusals in the denominator. Require at least 5/6 complete candidate workflows per preset, with no fewer complete workflows or passed mug attempts than the paired baseline.
promotion_gate: Only after development passes, freeze unchanged inputs for all twelve final seeds in both presets and both suites. Require at least 10/12 complete candidate workflows per preset and at least two more completed workflows in total than the paired baseline. Do not change any other model, controller, camera, gripper torque or physical threshold. Retain every outcome, including spoon failures after a successful mug.
scope: Finite dinner reliability only. No arbitrary workspace, continuous vision, Intel, voice or hosted-demo claim. Exposed diagnostic scenes and prior final scenes are excluded from fitting and fresh physical selection. The prior spoon candidate remains unpromoted and unchanged. GitHub/HF stay private, originals and failed attempts remain preserved, and only the user may press final Submit.
